title: One Chat. 3 AI Agents. A Full Week of Content.
description:
I put 3 AI agents in one group chat and let them run my entire content pipeline 🤯

Researcher → Writer → Repurposer. One idea in, a full week of content out.

No copy-pasting between tools, no forgetting context. Just one chat, one team.

This is @teamily.ai 🐟

Comment "TEAM" and I'll DM you the link to try it.
